title: Alternative Death
description: This datapack reduces the maximum HP upon death, gradually restoring it over time.
body:
# **AlternativeDeath**
This data pack introduces an alternative death penalty and is designed for gameplay with **/gamerule keepInventory true** **(but it also has a version for playing without this rule)**. It caters to players who don’t want to lose their items upon death but still wish to feel the fear of dying.

### **Features**

- Two Versions Available – One for use with **keepInventory true** and another for standard gameplay.
- Death Penalty – Upon death, the player's maximum HP is reduced to 6 **(3 hearts)**.
- Health Regeneration – Restores 2 HP **(1 heart)** every 20 minutes **(24,000 ticks)** starting from the moment of death.
- In the version designed for **keepInventory true**, after death, the player's experience drops as three experience orbs **(items remain in the inventory)**.
- The data pack also works in multiplayer.

### **Compatibility Warning**
This datapack is not recommended for use alongside mods or other datapacks that modify player HP, as proper functionality is not guaranteed.

### **Note**
If you want to play with **/gamerule keepInventory true** enabled but don’t want to lose experience, simply use the version without keepInventory and enable **/gamerule keepInventory true** manually.
